operator_rules: Use one shared batch lineage only when all live mutations remain inside one family-owned guarded surface.
Execute live mutation per target through the wrapper even when the upstream conclusion manifest is shared.
Retain one post-verify plan per target; aggregate success never replaces per-target verification evidence.

A frozen audit-plan fallback is acceptable only when the aggregate live audit path is already known to be operationally unstable and the retained sample stays preview-only or pre-gate-only until the guarded family path resumes ownership.

summary.detail: S0F-1C now has a stable operator runbook that packages the retained P1 preview lineage, P2 guarded live sample, and P3 per-target clean-preserve verification into one repeatable multi-item remediation path.
summary.next_boundary: Future expansion may add more families, but each family must prove the same shared-upstream plus per-target guarded-apply plus per-target post-verify shape before entering this runbook.
